title: Strategic Outcome Sequencer — 90-day Delivery Map for Company Objectives
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build the Strategic Outcome Sequencer: a canonical 90-day delivery map that translates company-level objectives into time-boxed delivery sequences and explicit interlock points across Product, Eng, Design, and GTM. The goal is a repeatable artifact and lightweight toolset (templates + dashboard) that: 1) surfaces critical dependency windows, 2) exposes rollout gates and rollback criteria, 3) ties milestones to OKR measurable proxies, and 4) produces a per-team commitment ledger used in planning and weekly interlock. This ticket focuses on the first company run: map Q1 objectives into sequenced releases, validate cross-team commitments, and ship the sequencer template and one dashboard view to the Console for leadership consumption.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical 90-day sequencer doc is published in Confluence with clearly defined sequences, milestones, and rollback gates for each company objective.
Each cross-functional team (Eng, Design, Data, Security, GTM) has at least one named commitment and an agreed delivery window recorded in the sequencer.
A lightweight dashboard (internal Console view) shows sequences, dependency flags, and an estimated delivery confidence score; dashboard is accessible to execs and PMs.
Run a cross-team rehearsal (interlock meeting) scheduled and executed; decisions and unresolved blockers captured with owners and dates.
Sequencer template and run-book (how to use) are added to the PM playbook and linked from the company OKR page.
notes: 2025-02-20: Kickoff with executive sponsors (CTO, Head of Product). Aligned on sequencing concept and definition of delivery windows vs milestones. Action: PMs to draft per-objective milestones by 2025-02-27 (owner: Marcus Lee).

2025-02-25: Received initial milestone drafts from Core Platform and Dedicated teams. Noted mismatch in milestone granularity; agreed trade-off: prefer fewer, testable milestones rather than exhaustive lists.
2025-02-28: Design review (DES): proposed sequencer visual iterations — timeline vs swimlane. Design prefers swimlane for cross-team clarity; ENG requested compact timeline mode for weekly ops.

2025-03-03: Engineering feasibility: Eng leads flagged scalability risk for sequencing on Dedicated rollout due to auto-scaling policy changes (see ENG-4021). Workaround: mark as dependency and add canary step in sequencer.

2025-03-04: Draft sequencer published to Confluence for review: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/Sequencer-Q1-2025. Dashboard prototype (read-only) created: https://internal-console.redwood.ai/dashboard/seq-proto. Feedback requested by 2025-03-10.

Follow-ups: (1) PMs to collect final commitments and confidence scores; (2) Eng to add canary gating PR (GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5421); (3) Design to finalize swimlane visual for Console embedding (Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/Sequencer-UI).
